question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cotarminous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**cotarminous**" is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**coterminous**".
 
• Which means having the same boundaries or extent in space, time, or meaning. (स्थान, समय या अर्थ में समान सीमाएँ या विस्तार होना)
